caption:
The freight lift is a masterpiece of mechanical spite. Finally reached the docking bay, which smells like damp concrete and old electricity. I just need to grab the crate and leave, but the manifest screen just had a very interesting, very red 'glitch.' My heart is doing a weird double-thump. Now I’m trying to look natural while the ceiling starts to watch. 🦾

Eve freezes as the security drone locks its lens onto her face.

#NeoTokyo #DockingBay #Glitch #CargoRun #CyberpunkLife #Subject01 #HiddenTruths
